$comment: What the A64 sheets show that LLVM's AArch64 TableGen and the unofficial Sail do not carry: sections (the top-level encoding groups), groups, formats, each row's mnemonic and assembly (LLVM writes operands through its own printers), description and pseudocode, register names, in the decoder's order. fix makes several rows of one LLVM instruction with an operand fixed (b.eq ... b.nv, msr spsel / daifset / daifclr); llvmFixed names LLVM operands that cover bits the Sail writes as literals (ADD's imm{13} over the reserved shift bit). tools/isa/gen-a64.mjs merges them into src/isa/generated/a64.mjs.
